scope: Independent Gaussian OUBM likelihood refit of a publicly available PETS mirror of C. andinus; NOT authors' Dryad-archive byte-identical reproduction

source.metadata_log_transformed: no (catalog flag; observed trait mean already near 2.645 log micrometre in the source-data units)

model.family: univariate moving-optimum OUBM with Brownian latent optimum and independent source innovations
model.trait_transform: NONE: source trait_mean already matches publication ln(micrometre) scale; avoid second ln
likelihood_implementations: independent full n-by-n multivariate-normal covariance + Cholesky

fit.optimizer: pure JavaScript Nelder-Mead multi-start using independently implemented Kalman Gaussian likelihood

unpooled_crosscheck.interpretation: Shows why using the paper's variance pooling contract matters; do not overwrite the pooled primary fit

evidence_tiers.mathematical_likelihood_match: PASS (Kalman vs dense Gaussian, absolute difference <1e-12)
evidence_tiers.same_public_mirror_series: PASS (tsID582, n266, 0.30941525 Myr, source trait units)
evidence_tiers.published_AICc_and_half_life_approximati: PASS_NEAR (AICc gap 0.0844 and half-life 12.009 yr vs reported about 12)
evidence_tiers.authors_Dryad_archive_exact_refit: OPEN (403 binary route / 401 unauthenticated API, original archived script unavailable)
evidence_tiers.table2_taxon_parameter_mapping: OPEN (conflict in rendered article table vs Table1 and prose)

cautions: PETS mirror may differ from the authors' archived data, variance pooling or package-source versions.
An AICc value slightly lower than published by 0.084 is not a source error.
The original model-conditional half-life estimate has uncertainty including near-immediate response, per source paper.
Exact reciprocity construction is a latent-coordinate gauge until independent ecological state semantics are justified.
These results do not imply authors' biological adaptation claims are false or that phylogenetic OU models are covered.
